decisions.reason: Because the chart visualization plugin builds directly on the firm's existing web-GIS and map.apps knowledge and already showed rapid post-launch iteration, management is likely to keep refining it rather than withdraw it.

Although the hierarchical search plugin fits the firm's technical base, its weaker market visibility and likely overlap with other search offerings make it the most plausible candidate to be taken off the market.

The mobile layer control component is closely related to the firm's established map-interface capabilities, and its prominent homepage positioning suggests enough expected learning and demand to continue.
A platform for building GIS solutions sits at the core of the firm's accumulated knowledge and commercial model, so absorptive capacity and strategic importance both favor keeping it.

Mobile field data capture is an adjacent extension of the firm's GIS expertise that the firm can likely improve through its existing development and consulting knowledge, so it is more likely to be retained.
The search extension for web map apps is a reusable add-on that fits the firm's established web-mapping competencies, making continued commercialization and incremental improvement likely.
